rule_or_requirement: A local candidate must preserve the verified pixel-only runtime and exact checkpoint when placed in a submission-shaped ZIP.
observable_information: Fixed control ZIP bytes and SHA-256, confirmed candidate module bytes and SHA-256, exact archive payload names and hashes.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Create a local ZIP with unchanged control payloads except root agent.py and the added stable-risk runtime module; do not upload or confirm a model.
expected_success_endpoint: A ZIP whose manifest records exact control/source/file/archive hashes and whose root agent wraps the confirmed candidate, ready for separate ZIP-exact local evaluation.
control: Frozen full-road-guard ZIP with exact SHA-256; no new model weights.
falsifier: Control or candidate source hash mismatch, missing or extra unintended payload, invalid archive, or wrapper behavior differing from the confirmed candidate.
smallest_decisive_experiment: One registered package execution, then read the archive manifest and inspect the ZIP payload identities; run ZIP-exact driving only in a new plan.
resource_and_risk_gate: Local-only 600-second package profile; no training, evaluation cell access, official site upload, model confirmation, or submission.
